newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung seeks 5 trln won home appliances sales.
newsitem.headline: Samsung seeks 5 trln won home appliances sales.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Electronics Co Ltd, the flagship of Samsung Group, said on Wednesday it had set a target of five trillion won in home electronic appliance sales in the year 2000.
A company statement said Samsung posted above 2.3 trillion won in home electronic appliance sales last year.
It said Samsung would focus on developments of five core home appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, microwave ovens and vacuum cleaners.
Samsung Electronics plans to expand overseas plants to 25 in 12 countries by 2000 from the current seven in six nations. The company gave no details of where the plants would be sited.
The statement said Samsung would also boost its exports ratio of home electronic appliances to 70 percent by 2000 from the current 35 percent.
